summary: Millicom International Cellular S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for Q1 2026 and an earnings release. The filing is a routine periodic report for a foreign private issuer, disclosing financial results and operational updates such as the recent acquisition of Colombia Telecomunicaciones. There is no mention of any special situation event like an M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, go-private, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, or management change. The filing lacks any transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics indicative of a special situation. This is a standard earnings and financial statement disclosure with no event-driven content.
